title: Integration by substitution
objective: Recognize reverse chain rule patterns, manage constant factors and bounds, and verify by differentiation.

items: A change of variable that simplifies an integral.
Replacing $u$ with its original expression in $x$.

items.label: Change bounds
items.note: Use bounds in the same variable as the integrand.

blocks.title: Common errors
blocks.md: Check the constant and sign in $du$. Rewrite remaining factors completely. Use matching bounds and variables, and include $+C$ for indefinite answers.

blocks.title: Written exam practice
blocks.md: Write the $u$ and $du$ lines. When you convert bounds, show both conversions. Differentiate a proposed antiderivative to check every inner factor.

blocks.title: Integration using u-substitution
blocks.focus: Write the differential line and check which entire factor gets replaced.

steps.title: Choose inside
steps.why: The derivative of the radical’s inside matches the leftover factor up to a constant.

steps.title: Return to x
steps.why: The derivative multiplies by $(3/2)(2x)$, canceling the coefficient.

steps.title: Change variable
steps.why: The sine factor matches with a minus sign.

steps.title: Change bounds
steps.why: Bounds now follow the new variable.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.why: Reversing the bounds cancels the minus sign.

steps.title: Substitute
steps.why: Every factor must use the new variable.

steps.title: Distribute
steps.why: Two power rules now finish the integral.

steps.title: Back-substitute
steps.why: The answer is a function of the original variable.
